pages.text: Every hazard below has its suit, crafted like ordinary armour.

$(item)Refractory Suit$(): corundum and moissanite. A full suit is proof against $(fluid)Basaltic Magma$() - you can wade in it and mine the magnetite under it - against $(fluid)Deep Brine$(), lava, and every fire.
$(item)Pressure Suit$(): bridgmanite and ringwoodite, minerals made under the mantle's weight. Each piece takes a level off $(thing)Lithostatic Pressure$(); a full suit cancels it at any depth.

$(thing)Radiation plating$() goes on any armour, of any mod. Put an armour piece and a plate together in a crafting grid: $(item)Light$() (lead) stops 10% of the radiation dose per piece, $(item)Medium$() (lead and graphite) 18%, $(item)Heavy$() (lead, graphite and boron carbide) 25% - four heavy-plated pieces stop all but 5%. A better plate replaces a worse one. Wear it in the Natural Reactor.
